# New Year’s Portfolio Cleaning

Report 153 | Published 2025-01-05 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2025-1-5/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/153.json)

Liquidity caution and healthcare thesis revisions.

The stronger 2025 equity-caution call was supported by lower return, higher realized volatility and a deeper drawdown. The Fed liquidity arithmetic overstated balance-sheet shrinkage, and midyear QT timing was early. CVS operating recovery coexisted with acquisition impairment; its verdict must remain mixed. The BMY sale expressed lost conviction, not an outperformance forecast.

**Coverage:** Read all macro, bitcoin, portfolio-change rationale, healthcare and gold sections. Historical quotations retain original horizons; neutral BMY exit is not recast as a bearish forecast. Source contains an edit dated 1/7/2024 within a January 2025 article, an apparent year error and sign of later editing.

## Claims

### 153-C01

**Fed removed over $3tn liquidity.**

| Field | Assessment |
| --- | --- |
| Verdict | Wrong |
| Type | empirical |
| Horizon | Not specified |
| Conditions | Not specified |
| Author modality | asserted |
| Asset or variable | qt-balance-sheet-arithmetic |
| Source blocks | 10 |
| Thesis family | qt-balance-sheet-arithmetic |

From the maximum 2022 total-asset level to January 2025, the decline was about $2.113tn, not over $3tn. If another liquidity concept is intended it must be named; the paragraph explicitly refers to balance-sheet reduction.

**Direction:** Contradicted for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Evaluate the explanation separately from subsequent price direction.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [WALCL downloaded observations](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/WALCL) | FRED / originating agency | 2026-11-07 | Verified in the audit

April 13 2022 assets $8.965487tn; January 1 2025 $6.852491tn; difference $2.112996tn. Latest vintage, cutoff November 7 2026.
